definitions.explanation: Any material that has been published, including books, magazines, newspapers, and other printed or digital works.

examples.japanese: {出版物|しゅっぱんぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{売|う}り{上|あ}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}っている→減る：01985_heru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{出版物|しゅっぱんぶつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無断|むだん}→無断：13382_mudan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{転載|てんさい}→転載：14359_tensai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: This publication must not be reproduced without permission.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧{出版物|しゅっぱんぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The market for digital publications is expanding year by year.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{出版|しゅっぱん}→出版：03222_shuppan⟧ (publishing) + ⟦{物|ぶつ}→〜物：28336_butsu⟧ (thing, object). The suffix ⟦{物|ぶつ}→〜物：28336_butsu⟧ turns the action of publishing into a concrete product.

USAGE:
A formal word used in legal, business, and academic contexts. Covers all forms of published material — books, magazines, pamphlets, and increasingly digital publications as well.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧{出版物|しゅっぱんぶつ} (digital/electronic publication)
- ⟦{定期|ていき}→定期：03538_teiki⟧{出版物|しゅっぱんぶつ} (periodical)
- {出版物|しゅっぱんぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{著作権|ちょさくけん}→著作権：14022_chosakuken⟧ (copyright of publications)
